source_doc: Genuin x LiveRamp - Identity Integration Framework

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Lightweight JavaScript snippet that publishers embed to render a personalised vertical short-form video feed on their page or app surface.

entities.name: Genuin Player
entities.description: Embedded video player inside the Genuin SDK that hosts the LiveRamp ATS JavaScript tag for real-time envelope generation in authenticated sessions.

entities.name: Recommendation Engine
entities.description: Genuin component that handles all content assembly and delivery for the publisher video feed.

entities.name: Genuin Ad Engine
entities.description: Server-side ad engine that controls direct-sold placements (Sponsored Takeover and Sponsored Post) and emits ad API requests with identity envelopes to buying partners.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Direct-sold ad placement controlled by Genuin's ad engine server-side, used in onsite and offsite direct deals across the network.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Direct-sold ad placement controlled by Genuin's ad engine, served as part of BYOA direct inventory.

entities.name: In-Feed Video
entities.description: Programmatic video placement served across Genuin inventory via SSPs/DSPs through oRTB and VAST pipelines.

entities.name: In-Stream Video
entities.description: Programmatic video placement served across Genuin inventory via SSPs/DSPs through VAST and VMAP pipelines.

entities.name: genuinID
entities.description: Genuin's internal user identifier used as the tokenisation key for envelope storage and for user-level exposure and engagement logs returned to clients.

entities.name: Local Encoder
entities.description: LiveRamp Docker image that runs in Genuin's own cloud, batch-processes hashed email and device IDs, and outputs identity envelopes without consumer data leaving Genuin's infrastructure.

entities.name: ATS
entities.description: LiveRamp real-time mechanism that generates a fresh identity envelope client-side when a user authenticates in-session via sign-in, newsletter, or registration.

entities.name: ATS Direct
entities.description: LiveRamp documented direct-deal flow where matched ATS users surface a Deal ID consumed by GPT to communicate with Google Ad Manager; tightly coupled to GAM as the ad server.

entities.name: Sidecar
entities.description: SSP-run LiveRamp application that decrypts an identity envelope in the programmatic bid stream and surfaces the resolved RampID to the DSP.

entities.name: LiveRamp Identity Envelope
entities.description: Base64-encoded encrypted identity signal valid for 15 days, generated by Local Encoder or ATS and passed in every Genuin bid request and direct ad API request.

entities.name: RampID
entities.description: LiveRamp's resolved person-level identifier returned after envelope decryption; used by DSPs and buying partners to apply their own segment matching and targeting.

entities.name: Envelope Decryption API
entities.description: Documented LiveRamp endpoint that a buying partner calls from their own infrastructure with their own LiveRamp credentials to resolve an envelope to a RampID in the direct path.

entities.name: ATS API Refresh Envelopes Endpoint
entities.description: LiveRamp ATS API endpoint that Genuin would use to refresh stored envelopes as they approach their 15-day expiry.

entities.name: SHA-256 Hashed Email
entities.description: Highest-fidelity signal Genuin holds for signed-in users; the anchor input to Local Encoder for envelope generation and the basis of deterministic matching.

entities.name: IDFA
entities.description: Apple's iOS advertising identifier available when ATT consent is granted; captured by the Genuin SDK as a deterministic signal where present.

entities.name: GAID
entities.description: Android mobile advertising identifier captured by the Genuin SDK for tracking-enabled Android users.

entities.name: Fingerprint Signals
entities.description: Combination of IP address, user agent, device model and make, and coarse location observed by the SDK for unauthenticated users; proposed as probabilistic match input but not documented as supported by LiveRamp.

entities.name: App Tracking Transparency
entities.description: Apple iOS framework whose opt-in requirement has significantly reduced IDFA coverage available to publishers and SDKs.

entities.name: Google Ad Manager
entities.description: Google's publisher ad server; ATS Direct depends on it for serving direct deals and resolving Deal IDs returned for matched ATS users.

entities.name: Google Publisher Tag
entities.description: Google client-side tag used in the ATS Direct flow to communicate matched Deal IDs from the browser to Google Ad Manager.

entities.name: Prebid.js
entities.description: Header bidding setup through which ATS-generated envelopes travel into the programmatic bid stream for SSP-side Sidecar decryption.

entities.name: oRTB
entities.description: Programmatic bidding protocol used by Genuin to expose in-feed and in-stream video inventory to SSPs and DSPs.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: IAB video ad serving standard used in the programmatic pipelines for Genuin's in-feed and in-stream video placements.

entities.name: VMAP
entities.description: IAB ad-break playlist standard used alongside VAST in Genuin's in-stream programmatic video delivery.

entities.name: Data Clean Room
entities.description: LiveRamp environment in which the client handles identity resolution, segment matching, and post-delivery attribution; Genuin's preferred path is to participate as a publisher collaborator.

entities.name: ECR Credentials
entities.description: LiveRamp-provisioned credentials and LiveRamp-managed encryption keys required to run Local Encoder; the basis for the required commercial relationship with LiveRamp.

entities.name: LiveRamp Console
entities.description: LiveRamp account console where ATS is provisioned and where, under ATS Direct, brands activate segments to a publisher's account.

entities.name: LiveRamp Connect
entities.description: LiveRamp commercial offering referenced as a possible seat option, contrasted with a lightweight publisher onboarding path.

entities.name: Safe Haven
entities.description: LiveRamp seat tier referenced as a heavyweight alternative to a hypothetical lightweight publisher onboarding path for Local Encoder.

entities.name: TCF/GPP
entities.description: Consent signalling frameworks Genuin includes alongside envelopes for non-opted-out US users; opted-out users do not receive an envelope and run contextual.

entities.name: LiveRamp
entities.description: Identity resolution infrastructure provider specified across Genuin's active client proposals as the preferred identity layer for audience matching and closed-loop attribution.

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: Existing LiveRamp customer and Genuin publisher/brand partner cited as a candidate parent under which Genuin could be provisioned as a LiveRamp child account.

entities.name: Publishers
entities.description: Third-party destinations that integrate the Genuin SDK to render the video feed and, in some flows, surface authenticated email signals into the SDK.

entities.name: SSPs
entities.description: Programmatic partners that receive Genuin bid requests, run the LiveRamp Sidecar application to decrypt envelopes, and surface resolved RampIDs to DSPs.

entities.name: DSPs
entities.description: Programmatic buyers that consume RampIDs surfaced by SSP Sidecar, apply their own segment logic, and own targeting end-to-end in the programmatic path.

entities.name: BYOA Model
entities.description: Direct-deal model for onsite and offsite sponsored placements in which the buying partner's ad decision engine resolves identity, applies targeting, and selects creative, and Genuin serves what the partner decides.

entities.name: Child Account
entities.description: LiveRamp parent-child account structure under which an existing customer can provision a partner like Genuin under their existing agreement with billing flowing through the parent.

entities.name: Identity Integration Framework
aliases: Genuin x LiveRamp Identity Integration Framework
entities.description: May 2026 confidential working document capturing Genuin's understanding of a LiveRamp integration, the clean room data flow, RampID fetching mechanics, matching signal approaches, and open validation questions.

entities.name: Retail Media Networks
entities.description: Client category in Genuin's active proposals that specifies LiveRamp as the preferred identity resolution infrastructure for segment activation and attribution.

entities.name: Commerce Media Networks
entities.description: Client category in Genuin's active proposals that specifies LiveRamp as the preferred identity resolution infrastructure.

entities.name: Brand Partners
entities.description: Brand-side clients and buying partners in Genuin's active proposals; they own targeting, hold the LiveRamp seat, and call the Envelope Decryption API in the direct BYOA path.

entities.name: Signed-In Users
entities.description: Users who have authenticated on a publisher page so Genuin holds an email address that can be SHA-256 hashed for Local Encoder envelope generation.

entities.name: Tracking-Enabled Users
entities.description: Mobile users who have not opted out of device tracking, allowing the SDK to capture IDFA on iOS (with ATT consent) or GAID on Android as deterministic signals.

entities.name: Unauthenticated Users
entities.description: Users who are not signed in and whose device ID is inaccessible, for whom Genuin can only observe browser and device fingerprint signals via the SDK.

relationships.description: The SDK embeds the player surface that hosts vertical video and the optional ATS JavaScript tag.
The SDK delegates all content assembly and delivery to Genuin's recommendation engine.
Publishers integrate the lightweight JavaScript snippet into their existing page or app surface.
Publishers use the SDK to render the personalised vertical video feed on their destination.
Sponsored Takeover is a direct-sold placement controlled server-side by Genuin's ad engine.
Sponsored Post is a direct-sold placement controlled server-side by Genuin's ad engine.
In-feed programmatic inventory is exposed through standard oRTB pipelines.
In-feed programmatic placements are served via VAST.
In-stream programmatic placements are served via VAST.
In-stream programmatic placements use VMAP alongside VAST.
The direct path operated by Genuin's ad engine follows the Bring Your Own Algorithm model where the buying partner decides creative.
BYOA direct ad API requests carry the LiveRamp identity envelope as the identity signal for the buying partner.
BYOA requires the buying partner to call LiveRamp's Envelope Decryption API on their own infrastructure to resolve the envelope.
Local Encoder is LiveRamp's batch envelope generation product.
Local Encoder is Genuin's primary path for batch-generating identity envelopes from known user identifiers within Genuin's own cloud.
HEM is the confirmed Addressability input for Local Encoder envelope generation.
IDFA is a documented Local Encoder input, though Addressability support is an open question.
GAID is a documented Local Encoder input, though Addressability support is an open question.
Local Encoder requires LiveRamp-provisioned ECR access and LiveRamp-managed encryption keys.
ATS is LiveRamp's Authenticated Traffic Solution for real-time envelope generation.
ATS generates a fresh identity envelope client-side at the moment of in-session authentication.
ATS envelopes travel through Prebid.js or equivalent header bidding setups into the programmatic bid stream.
A LiveRamp ATS JavaScript tag is embedded in Genuin's player to generate envelopes when an email signal is surfaced in session.
ATS Direct is LiveRamp's documented direct-deal mechanism layered on ATS.
ATS Direct is tightly coupled to GAM as the ad server, which does not match Genuin's direct architecture.
GPT communicates the returned Deal ID from the publisher's browser to Google Ad Manager under ATS Direct.
GPT is the client-side tag that talks to GAM in standard ad serving and in ATS Direct.
The Refresh Envelopes endpoint is part of the LiveRamp ATS API surface.
Sidecar is the LiveRamp application that SSPs run to decrypt envelopes.
SSPs run the Sidecar application in the programmatic bid path to decrypt identity envelopes.
Sidecar decrypts identity envelopes received in the bid request.
DSPs receive resolved RampIDs from Sidecar and apply their own segment matching and targeting.
Decrypting an envelope yields a RampID, which buying systems then act on.
The Envelope Decryption API is a documented LiveRamp developer endpoint.
The API takes a publisher-generated envelope as input and returns the resolved RampID.
In the BYOA direct path the buying partner calls the Envelope Decryption API on their own infrastructure using their own LiveRamp credentials.
The identity envelope is LiveRamp's standard transport-layer identity signal.
RampID is LiveRamp's resolved person-level identifier.
LiveRamp Console is LiveRamp's account console used to provision ATS and activate brand segments to publisher accounts.
LiveRamp Connect is a LiveRamp seat option referenced as a heavyweight alternative to a publisher onboarding path.
Safe Haven is a LiveRamp seat referenced as a heavyweight alternative for a publisher Local Encoder deployment.
ECR credentials are LiveRamp-provisioned and required to operate Local Encoder.
The data clean room is the LiveRamp environment in which the client performs identity resolution, segment matching, and attribution.
The parent-child account structure is a LiveRamp commercial model under which a parent customer can provision partners under their existing agreement.
iHeart is an existing LiveRamp customer cited as a candidate parent for provisioning Genuin as a child account.
iHeart is named as an example of a publisher partner in Genuin's active partnerships.
Retail media network clients specify LiveRamp as their preferred identity resolution infrastructure.
Commerce media network clients specify LiveRamp as their preferred identity resolution infrastructure.
Brand clients require LiveRamp identity matching to push segments into their buying systems and receive Genuin exposure data back for closed-loop attribution.
For authenticated users on a publisher page, Genuin holds an email it can SHA-256 hash before submission to LiveRamp.
iOS tracking-enabled users with granted ATT consent contribute IDFA as a deterministic device signal.
Android tracking-enabled users contribute GAID as a deterministic device signal.
For unauthenticated users without device IDs, the SDK can only observe a combination of IP, user agent, device model/make, and coarse location.
IDFA is only available on iOS when ATT consent has been granted; ATT has significantly reduced coverage.
For non-opted-out US users Genuin includes the TCF/GPP consent signal alongside the envelope; opted-out users do not receive an envelope and run contextual.
The framework document captures Genuin's working understanding of the LiveRamp integration for validation prior to onboarding.
Section 2 of the framework describes the expected integration flow into a client's data clean room account.
The framework documents the BYOA direct path as the model in which buying partners own targeting and Genuin serves what they decide.
Section 3 of the framework analyses Local Encoder as Genuin's preferred batch envelope generation mechanism.
Section 3 of the framework analyses ATS as a secondary, complementary real-time envelope generation path.
The framework's open questions raise the partner-provisioned child account model as Genuin's preferred path to LiveRamp access.
